variants.text: A young adult with an oval face, almond-shaped eyes, and voluminous layered brown hair, wearing large hoop earrings.
A young adult woman with an oval face, prominent cheekbones, almond-shaped eyes, and a straight nose. She has voluminous layered brown hair and wears large circular hoop earrings.

Young adult with an oval face, prominent cheekbones, and a rounded chin. Features include medium-thin arched eyebrows, almond-shaped eyes with double eyelids, and a straight nose with a rounded tip. She has medium-width lips, a short philtrum, and wears large circular hoop earrings. Her hair is voluminous, layered, and brown, styled to the side.
This young woman has an oval face with prominent cheekbones and almond-shaped eyes. She has voluminous, layered brown hair and is wearing large circular hoop earrings and dark makeup.
